scope: DspSection.ptable2, upstream octabam's second table block: placed straight after the ptable, with its own $fab2e0 literal, in every P placement (run cursor, X slot, DEV, split table) through one substitution; a ptable2 without exactly one literal, or a literal without one, is refused. Only a module that declares a ptable2 takes the new path (Sidechain Compressor 0.2.0). Two fresh native builds of the floating-cave record's 128 selections, one with the base commit's build_bus.py and schema.py and one with these, in the pinned toolchain image with the static stock loader, both with the base commit's Sidechain Compressor folder (0.1.2, no ptable2) so the builder is the only difference. Every built image is identical (100) and every refusal is identical (28). No hardware result is inferred.
